faq.faqSectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about our online training and AI conversation practice

0.question: How do your online lessons work?
0.answer: You meet your personal trainer via video call for 1:1 sessions tailored to your job. Content comes from your real work situations — not pre-recorded or AI-only. Flexible scheduling fits around your workday.

1.question: What technology do I need for online sessions?
1.answer: Just a browser, camera, and microphone. Our platform works on any device. We also support Teams, Zoom, and Google Meet if your company prefers those tools.

2.question: How does AI conversation practice work?
2.answer: George Patterson, your AI conversation partner, practices English with you 24/7 between your real lessons. He knows your lesson content, adapts to your level, and gives instant feedback on grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation.

3.question: Who is George Patterson?
3.answer: George is your AI conversation partner, customized to your company and industry. He is infinitely patient, available anytime, and remembers your progress and learning goals from session to session.

4.question: Can the AI avatar be customized for our company?
4.answer: Yes. Avatars are tailored with your industry-specific vocabulary, company context, and specialized knowledge. Each team member gets a personalized practice experience relevant to their role.

5.question: What is the Simmonds Method?
5.answer: Your Reality. Your Content. Your Results. Training built from your actual work situations, not textbooks. Every session uses your real meetings, emails, and presentations. Proven over 20 years with German professionals.

6.question: How is this different from standard language schools?
6.answer: No generic courses or textbook exercises. Every session uses your real meetings, emails, and presentations. Your AI conversation partner reinforces what you learn between lessons — something traditional schools cannot offer.

7.question: How long does it take to see results?
7.answer: Most clients notice improved confidence within 4–6 sessions. Significant fluency gains typically occur within 3–6 months with regular online training and AI conversation practice between lessons.

8.question: What does a typical training package include?
8.answer: Usually 24 online sessions over 6–9 months, plus AI avatar access for unlimited conversation practice between lessons. Packages are customized to your goals and schedule.

9.question: Can my employer pay for the training?
9.answer: Yes, we invoice companies directly and provide all necessary documentation. Language training is VAT-exempt in Germany. HR departments regularly arrange corporate training packages with us.

10.question: Do you train entire corporate teams?
10.answer: Yes. Online group training for 2–6 participants with custom content for your industry and company. Each team member also gets individual AI avatar access for conversation practice.

11.question: Can we start with a trial session?
11.answer: Contact us for a free consultation. We'll discuss your goals, assess your current level, and recommend the right training format — no obligation.

12.question: Is face-to-face training also available?
12.answer: Yes, in Hannover and Berlin. However, most of our clients choose online training for its flexibility and equal effectiveness. We recommend online for the best scheduling options.

13.question: What's your cancellation policy?
13.answer: 24 hours notice for online sessions, 48 hours for face-to-face. Late cancellations may be charged at the full session rate. We understand business schedules can be unpredictable.
